approveApiPlan.semantics: per-item transaction (lock row + quality + source + same-version passed review + fp). NOT a 100-item atomic batch.
mustNot: use cv=1 review for cv=2 items
approveApiPlan.backupBefore: mysqldump / JSON snapshot of 100 CAND rows + reviews before first approve
approveApiPlan.execution: sequential per-item; record HTTP per code; on first failure STOP; success count = actual 200s only
